title: Compare E2F1, PATZ1 and TP73 motif curves at the human ΔNp73 TSS

catalog.notes: Offline real-locus native TSS walkthrough on the retained public TP73 RefSeq excerpt. Recovers the GenBank REGION anchor, previews all five annotated starts (the P1/TAp73 start is reported missing_flanks because the excerpt has no upstream sequence), approves only the internal ΔNp73 start at 1:3690672, then computes and exports locally scored E2F1 MA0024.3, PATZ1 MA1961.2 and TP73 MA0861.2 curves. Every step has GUI, Agent Assistant and inner-agent parity; ui open tss-view --local-score is GUI-hosted, while promoters tss-view-svg provides headless local scoring and export. Separate non-cross-calibrated scales, unavailable-not-zero bands, no occupancy or reporter claim. Screenshots and native acceptance remain pending.
